name: EZ Bar Upright Row
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold an EZ bar overhand across your thighs on the outer angled grips.
Brace your core and lead with your elbows to pull the bar vertically close to your torso toward upper chest height.
Pause briefly with your elbows out to your sides and slightly higher than your hands.
Lower the bar slowly along your torso back to full arm extension.
tips: Pull to about mid-to-upper chest height rather than jamming your shoulders into impingement.
Keep the bar gliding close to your body without swinging your hips to heave the weight.
